    Bug 2046892 - Add missing NS_ENSURE_SUCCESS after Finalize in NS_NewMailnewsURI. r=babolivier
    
    
    The Exchange URL path introduced in bug 2040117 calls Finalize(uriResult)
    but doesn't check the return value before dereferencing uriResult on the
    next line. If Finalize fails (e.g. on a malformed spec), this causes a
    null-deref crash.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D306384

diff --git a/mailnews/base/src/nsNewMailnewsURI.cpp b/mailnews/base/src/nsNewMailnewsURI.cpp
index acce2ebb5bd..19e168d8ca0 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/src/nsNewMailnewsURI.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/base/src/nsNewMailnewsURI.cpp
@@ -143,6 +143,7 @@ nsresult NS_NewMailnewsURI(nsIURI** aURI, const nsACString& aSpec,
     rv = NS_MutateURI(new mozilla::net::nsStandardURL::Mutator())
              .SetSpec(aSpec)
              .Finalize(uriResult);
+    NS_ENSURE_SUCCESS(rv, rv);
 
     nsAutoCString query;
     rv = uriResult->GetQuery(query);
title: Bug 2046892 - Add missing NS_ENSURE_SUCCESS after Finalize in NS_NewMailnewsURI. r=babolivier
